lines.1: 「Then I will return to my family home for a while.」
lines.3: 「Yes. I expect to return here on August thirtieth. Take care of yourself until then.」
lines.4: 「If it comes to it, I'll take care of him from head to toe.」
lines.5: 「I don't like the sound of that.」
lines.6: 「No, Leo relies on you a little too much, Date.」
lines.7: 「I will leave you a schedule. Follow it and you should have no trouble.」
lines.9: 「I made plenty of rice balls for lunch and tonight. Make sure you eat them.」
lines.11: 「There are snacks I bought in the cupboard. Do not eat so many that you get cavities.」
lines.13: 「Call me without hesitation if anything goes wrong.」
lines.15: 「Otome, I appreciate it, but you'll miss your train.」
lines.16: 「Mm. I see... Then I am leaving.」
lines.18: Otome waves and calls loudly despite the crowd around her.
lines.19: ...It's a little embarrassing, but that is simply who she is.
lines.22: 「I might've liked a big sister like her.」
lines.23: He does have a thing for older women.
lines.24: We pass through the shopping street.
lines.25: We go past the flower shop, but she isn't there.
lines.27: 「You notice every little thing, don't you?」
lines.33: 「I love this flower shop Dad created.」
lines.36: She joins her hands before the memorial portrait of the father she respects.
lines.37: 「Dad... I'll protect Mom. I won't give her to anyone else.」
lines.38: 「And I won't let your memory disappear.」
